description: Local box: the Attempt runs in a real directory tree on this machine (`environment: local`). Workspace, home, and evaluation paths map onto the host filesystem. ACP attaches a real process pipe. This is a production kind, not a test double.

Docker box: the Attempt runs in a container built from the task recipe (`environment: docker`). Container id, `docker exec`, and UID mapping stay inside this package. Neighbors only see Protocol methods (`upload` / `exec` / `attach_stdio`). The host needs a working Docker engine.

E2B box: the Attempt runs in an [E2B](https://e2b.dev) cloud sandbox built from the task recipe (`environment: e2b`). This host needs `uv sync --extra e2b` and an API key. Hub listing does not mean this machine can run it; lock/run stay skip / fail-closed when the extra or key is missing.

SSH box: the Attempt runs on a remote machine, or in a container on it (`environment: ssh`). Empty `environment_options.image` uses the remote host as the box; a pre-existing image tag runs that container over SSH. Host/user/key locators are resolved at preflight and never enter the lock. Live ACP stdio over bare SSH is not a supported path.

Daytona box: the Attempt runs in a [Daytona](https://www.daytona.io) sandbox from an OCI snapshot (`environment: daytona`). Snapshot names and sandbox ids stay in this package. This host needs `uv sync --extra daytona` and `DAYTONA_API_KEY`. Hub listing does not mean this machine can run it.

Coding-agent executor: parent is the only [ACP](https://agentclientprotocol.com) JSON-RPC client (`executor: acp` + `options.entry`). Vendor CLIs stay behind a process-out ACP entry (native, shim, or vendor package). Injects `environment.attach_stdio`. Official Attempt images bake entries at build time; invoke does not `npm i`.

OpenAI-compatible HTTP executor (`executor: openai-http`). Posts Chat Completions to `base_url` with a scoped API-key env locator. Native `tools=` / `tool_calls` are first-class. No Attempt box and no `attach_stdio`. Default base is `https://api.openai.com/v1`.
